paragraphs.text: Cerise , Slayer of Fear , is a Human Cleric Knight from Eldraine .

Cerise is a young healer from Castle Ardenvale who undertook her first quest just after turning eighteen. She is a friend of Rowan and romantic crush of Will Kenrith 's. She rides the bearded unicorn Sophos . She took the challenge of the Wicked Slumber head-on by proclaiming to be an insomniac.
